capture.storage: private diagnostic capture under /tmp/process2-xbox-resource-capture; raw stream is not committed

implementation.contract: big-endian dword framing for PM4 types 0, 1, 2, and 3 plus zero-dword NOP; recursively frames only the captured three-dword PM4_INDIRECT_BUFFER form through a caller-supplied bounded guest-memory reader

unit_tests: shift_xbox_guest_ring_check passed on Linux and Redmi Note 8 Pro arm64-v8a
cases: type-0, type-1, type-2, type-3, and zero-dword NOP framing
captured PM4_INDIRECT_BUFFER address/length extraction and invalid span rejection
bounded indirect-buffer expansion with source address and nesting-depth provenance
short guest-memory mapping and cyclic indirect-buffer rejection without output mutation
captured type-3 DRAW_INDX span handed to the bounded draw decoder
truncated type-3 payload rejection without partial output mutation
regression.private_capture_check: host C++ scanner consumed all 19,784 bytes and decoded four DRAW_INDX spans at the listed offsets

indirect_buffer_fixture.test_payload: constructed 74 zero-dword NOPs for memory-reader bounds/provenance test; not data from ring.bin

limitations: Ring snapshot and indirect-buffer expansion are not wired to ReXGlue InitializeRingBuffer, CP_RB_WPTR, live guest memory, synchronization, or read-pointer writeback.
Register and shader state tracking are not implemented by this scanner.
ring.bin does not contain the bytes referenced by its PM4_INDIRECT_BUFFER packets; constructed expansion-test bytes are not evidence of the captured nested commands.
No project-owned Xenos microcode translation, Vulkan resource binding, EDRAM mapping, draw submission, phone rendering, or retail parity is claimed.
The raw capture remains outside the repository; the committed regression tests use a compact constructed framing stream.
